description: Reads one webinar as the full export payload the dashboard produces: every campaign field, the page content, the emails and the settings, as a JSON string. Read-only, it changes nothing. The payload is large (often tens of thousands of characters), so it is capped here at 20000 characters and the answer says when it was cut; the complete file is the Export button in the dashboard. Use it when the host wants to move a webinar to another site and will hand the payload to wi_import_webinar, or wants a backup of the settings. Do not use it to read a single value; wi_get_webinar and wi_get_webinar_settings are the cheaper way. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it.

name: wi_export_webinar
title: Read a webinar as an export payload
